# Security & Privacy Requirements Checklist: F119 E-Blast Two-Sided Approval

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements that govern authorisation, content safety, image ownership, personal data, erasure and audit — are they complete, unambiguous and consistent with Constitution Principle I before `/speckit.tasks`?
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It is reviewer-owned: `[x]` means the reviewer judged the requirements-quality criterion satisfied — it never means implementation is done. `/speckit.implement` reads this state but does not change it.

## Authorisation & Roles

- [x] CHK001 Is every new action mapped to exactly one existing permission (format/send version, confirm schedule, staff image upload, template image upload, brand colour/address, test copy), with no action left implied? [Completeness, Spec §Roles & permissions, §FR-041b]
- [x] CHK002 Is "only portal users of the member company that owns the E-Blast" defined for a company with several portal users — can any of them approve, and is that the intended trust model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Is the prohibition on staff giving member-side approval stated so that it also covers a staff user who happens to hold a portal account for that company? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases "staff submits on behalf"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): a staff user who also holds a portal account for the member company is not covered
- [x] CHK004 Are the `manager` role's read-only limits defined for the new screens (versions, feedback, brand settings, test copy)? [Completeness, Spec §Roles & permissions] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): manager read-only limits on brand settings / test copy / versions not stated
- [x] CHK005 Is the requirement that the Brand page never writes the invoice logo phrased as a testable negative (the contract test in FR-041b) and does it also cover clearing the logo? [Measurability, Spec §FR-041b]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for who may see another tenant's or another member's versions and feedback — is the cross-member probe (same tenant, other company) explicitly a deny-with-audit case? [Coverage, Spec §Tenant scope] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): cross-member (same tenant) probe: deny-with-audit not explicitly required

## Content Safety

- [x] CHK007 Is the content-safety rule for design blocks specific about what user input each block accepts (text, link, image, description) and that nothing else from the user reaches the email? [Clarity, Spec §Content safety, §FR-041]
- [x] CHK008 Is the requirement that marketing's version passes "the same content safety and size rules" stated to apply at every save and at send-to-member, not only at final send? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §Edge Cases "Formatted content breaks the content rules"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): content rules stated at send-to-member only, not at every save
- [x] CHK009 Are link requirements (scheme allow-list) stated for the call-to-action button and for editable link text so that a `javascript:` or data link is refused at the source, not only at send? [Coverage, Spec §Content safety, §FR-041]
- [x] CHK010 Does the spec state that block rendering must never re-introduce a path for user-supplied styling, and can that be verified from the requirement text? [Measurability, Spec §FR-041, §Content safety]
- [x] CHK011 Is the test-copy email required to carry the same content-safety treatment as a real send (so a test copy cannot become an unsanitised channel)? [Gap, Spec §FR-037] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): test copy not required to receive the same content-safety treatment as a real send

## Images & Ownership

- [x] CHK012 Is image ownership defined for all three upload contexts (member draft, staff-formatted version, template) including the negative cases: wrong E-Blast, wrong tenant, closed E-Blast? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040, §FR-046a, §Edge Cases "adds an image to another member's E-Blast"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): image upload to a CLOSED E-Blast not covered
- [x] CHK013 Does the spec name the existing member-upload defect (draft ownership never checked) as a requirement to fix, not only the new staff route? [Gap, Spec §US6, exploration § A "Images end to end"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): US6 does not name the existing member-upload ownership defect as a fix
- [x] CHK014 Is "images … must not remain reachable" defined for public storage — deletion vs. de-referencing — and is a timing bound given? [Clarity, Spec §Personal data] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): "must not remain reachable" — delete vs de-reference, and a time bound, not defined
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for an image referenced by both a template and one or more E-Blasts when one of them is erased (last-reference rule)? [Edge Case, Spec §Personal data, §FR-046a] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): last-reference rule for an image shared by a template and E-Blasts not defined

## Personal Data, Erasure & Export

- [x] CHK016 Is the lawful basis stated separately for the new free-text fields (marketing note, member reason, approval note) and for the brand postal address? [Completeness, Spec §Personal data]
- [x] CHK017 Are erasure and export requirements written to name every new record type (versions, member decisions, notes/reasons, images, notifications) so a future table cannot be missed? [Completeness, Spec §Personal data] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): notifications not named among the record types erasure/export must reach
- [x] CHK018 Is the erasure behaviour for an E-Blast in a NEW stage defined (cancel + redact, as today) and stated to include the marketing-authored version, which is not the member's words? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "erasure mid-flow"]
- [x] CHK019 Is the retention of versions and decisions tied to the parent E-Blast's retention with an explicit period, and does it match the 5-year audit retention where they overlap? [Clarity, Spec §Personal data, §Audit trail] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): retention period of the parent E-Blast not stated
- [x] CHK020 Does the spec state that the record of processing update is a precondition for the flag flip and name what it must describe (new fields, new recipients of staff email)? [Completeness, Spec §Personal data, §Feature flag] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): RoPA update content not named

## Audit Trail

- [x] CHK021 Is the audit event list complete for every state-changing action in the FRs (including brand changes, image uploads, test copies, expiry, withdrawn approval, the two trigger-exempt writes)? [Completeness, Spec §Audit trail] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): audit list lacks image uploads
- [x] CHK022 Is "free-text reasons and content are not copied into the audit trail" reconciled with FR-032's requirement that both sides see feedback in the history — is the history a separate record from the audit log? [Consistency, Spec §Audit trail vs §FR-032] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): history (FR-032) vs audit trail ("no free text") not reconciled as separate records
- [x] CHK023 Is the "true actor role" requirement stated for the member side (a portal user has no staff role) and for system-initiated events (expiry, reminders)? [Clarity, Spec §Audit trail] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): "true actor role" for member-side and system-initiated events not stated
- [x] CHK024 Can "a reviewer must be able to prove which version was sent and who approved it" be met from the audit requirements alone — is the version identity required in the send event? [Measurability, Spec §Audit trail, §SC-002]
